headline: ABRASILVER STRIKES 109m AT 221 g/t AG IN VIRGIN OCULTO WEST GAP — BEST PHASE VI HOLE EXPANDS DIABLILLOS BEYOND DFS MINE PLAN (TSX:ABRA)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / AbraSilver Resource Corp.
snippet: AbraSilver Resource Corp. (TSX: ABRA) released July 13 results from hole DDH 26-036 at Oculto West, a previously undrilled gap in the Diablillos silver-gold project in Salta Province, Argentina — returning 109.0 metres at 221.2 g/t silver and 0.72 g/t gold from 114.0 metres downhole, including 14.0 metres at 580 g/t Ag and 0.23 g/t Au from 135 metres. The intercept sits within and adjacent to the conceptual open pit modelled in the project's Definitive Feasibility Study, demonstrating that significant high-grade silver-gold mineralisation remains open in a gap the Phase VI resource model had not yet captured — directly pointing to expansion of the resource beyond the existing mine plan.

headline: SITKA DRILLS 348m AT 1.12 g/t AU INCL. 164m AT 1.83 g/t — BLACKJACK BULK-TONNAGE KEEPS EXPANDING AT YUKON'S 5.1 MOZ RC GOLD PROJECT (TSXV:SIG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Sitka Gold Corp.
snippet: Sitka Gold Corp. (TSXV: SIG) announced July 13 assay results from hole DDRCCC-26-128 at the Blackjack deposit within its RC Gold Project in the Yukon — returning 348.0 metres at 1.12 g/t gold including 164.0 metres at 1.83 g/t, 45.0 metres at 3.49 g/t, and high-grade sub-intervals of 2.0 metres at 15.35 g/t and 2.0 metres at 13.65 g/t. Sitka has now completed 24,000 metres in 47 holes of its planned 60,000-metre 2026 campaign using six active drill rigs across RC Gold's Blackjack and Rhosgobel deposits; the project already carries a 5.1 million ounce gold resource, and the continued width and grade at Blackjack suggest the deposit remains meaningfully open along strike and at depth.

headline: GALWAY CLARENCE STREAM MRE: 1.42 MOZ INDICATED + 1.29 MOZ INFERRED AU — 54% OUNCE GROWTH AND 103% ANTIMONY BOOST FROM 70,000m UPDATE (TSXV:GWM)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Galway Metals Inc.
snippet: Galway Metals Inc. (TSXV: GWM) released July 13 an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for its 100%-owned Clarence Stream Gold Project in southwestern New Brunswick — Indicated Mineral Resources of 27.2 million tonnes at 1.62 g/t Au containing 1.42 million ounces (54% increase from the 2022 estimate) and Inferred Mineral Resources of 28.5 million tonnes at 1.40 g/t Au containing 1.29 million ounces, with a 103% increase in Indicated antimony providing a critical mineral credit against today's elevated Sb prices. The update incorporates approximately 70,000 metres of diamond drilling completed since 2022; grade per tonne declined versus the prior estimate as broader lower-grade envelope was incorporated, and the Northern Miner flagged the resource as coming in below analyst forecasts — but with 2.71 million ounces total and antimony credits, the deposit's economics remain material for an advanced New Brunswick gold developer.

headline: G MINING-G2 GOLDFIELDS GUYANA GOLD HUB CLOSING LATE JULY — G3 GOLDFIELDS SPIN-OUT TERMS CONFIRMED, GMIN BECOMES AMERICAS ANCHOR (TSX:GMIN)
snippet: G Mining Ventures Corp. (TSX: GMIN) and G2 Goldfields Inc. confirmed July 13 that all remaining closing conditions for the plan of arrangement — under which GMIN acquires all G2 shares and G2 simultaneously spins out G3 Goldfields Inc. — are expected to be met by end of July 2026, with the effective date to be announced as conditions clear. G2 holders will receive 0.212 GMIN shares plus 0.5 G3 shares per G2 share; G3 Goldfields launches as a separate TSX-listed exploration vehicle with G2's legacy exploration assets, while the enlarged GMIN becomes one of the Americas' lowest-cost senior gold operators anchored by the Tocantinzinho mine in Pará State, Brazil and the Oko Main project in Guyana — a transaction designed to create a tier-one production hub in a jurisdiction where permitting and geopolitical risk are materially lower than the global average.

headline: 'GOLD'S NEXT MOVE HINGES ON ONE THING': MONEY METALS ON THE CPI BINARY, $4,150 RESISTANCE, AND WHY CENTRAL BANKS REMOVE THE FLOOR RISK
snippet: Money Metals Exchange's July 13 market commentary frames the precious metals market around a single binary: gold briefly pushed above $4,150 before retreating below $4,100 as Fed rate-hike fears generated by the Hormuz oil shock collide with the disinflation trend that was intact through May. Tuesday's June CPI print is the resolution mechanism — a soft or negative headline read collapses rate-hike odds and opens the path toward prior resistance levels, while a hot reading validates the Fed's restrictive stance and extends the summer correction. The piece anchors the bullish structural case in central bank accumulation that has persisted regardless of price level, with global central bank gold purchases sustaining a demand floor that operates independently of Western investment-market positioning.

headline: HONG KONG GOLD CLEARING IS NOW LIVE — 41 INSTITUTIONS JOIN 'HAU' BENCHMARK AS ASIA BIDS TO BREAK LBMA MONOPOLY ON GOLD PRICING
snippet: GoldSeek's structural analysis of Hong Kong's July 7 gold clearing system launch argues the 41-institution inaugural settlement session is more than a routine infrastructure event: the government-owned Hong Kong Precious Metals Central Clearing Company mirrors the LBMA's bilateral netting model, the 'Delivery Connect' link to the Shanghai Gold Exchange bridges Asian and Chinese liquidity pools, and the new HAU price ticker (co-developed with Bloomberg) creates the first Asian gold benchmark explicitly designed to rival London's AM/PM Fix. As gold continues to flow structurally from West to East, Hong Kong's new clearing infrastructure removes the friction that previously forced Asian buyers to price through London — an architectural shift that amplifies Eastern demand signals and represents the most consequential structural intervention in global bullion market infrastructure in decades.

headline: CENTENARIO MAPS 800m COPPER SKARN AT LOS REYES — 7.19% CU GRAB SAMPLE CONFIRMS MOLY-GOLD SYSTEM IN MEXICO'S FAJA DE PLATA (TSXV:CTG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Centenario Gold Corp.
snippet: Centenario Gold Corp. (TSXV: CTG) released July 13 assay results from surface and underground sampling at the Los Reyes Project in Chihuahua, Mexico — confirming a copper-molybdenum-gold skarn system extending more than 800 metres along a north-south granodiorite-limestone contact in the prolific Faja de Plata belt, with highlight grab samples returning 7.19% Cu and 2.88% Zn from the Jibosa zone and pervasive skarn alteration up to 120 metres wide at the El Rey concession. The sampling results validate the geological model guiding drill targeting for a planned 2026 maiden diamond drill program; the 45-hectare Los Reyes property contains the same Cu-rich skarn host rock that characterises several major producers in the region, and systematic channel sampling now being completed across the property will be used to prioritize the highest-probability first holes.

headline: OCEANAGOLD EARN-IN: CAROLINA RUSH COMPLETES BREWER PORPHYRY FIRST PROGRAM — FINAL HOLE EXTENDS EPITHERMAL SYSTEM SOUTHEAST, CONFIRMS LATERAL CONTINUITY (TSXV:RUSH)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Carolina Rush Corporation
snippet: Carolina Rush Corporation (TSXV: RUSH) announced July 13 final results from the initial three-hole deep drill program at the Brewer Gold-Copper Project in Chesterfield County, South Carolina — where OceanaGold may earn up to an 80% interest by funding US$20 million in exploration expenditures before 2030. Hole B26C-039, drilled approximately 400 metres southeast of the prior hole and collared near the former Brewer mine, intersected epithermal gold-copper mineralisation confirming lateral continuity of the hydrothermal system into a previously untested corridor; the program previously established the first evidence of porphyry-style copper-gold mineralisation beneath the surface epithermal lithocap — validating Brewer as one of the few untested porphyry targets in the southeastern United States carrying both a 43-101 resource and a major-producer earn-in.
